description: Li-Ren-Wen (2025) proved that gamma_{2,d} = 1/2 + Theta(1/sqrt(d)) for d random binary strings. By computing gamma_{2,d} for many d values and fitting the asymptotic expansion, one can extrapolate to d=2 more precisely. The known asymptotic form constrains the function shape, enabling tighter predictions.
mathematical_formalization: Known: gamma_{2,d} = 1/2 + c/sqrt(d) + O(d^{-1}) for large d. Fit gamma_{2,d} = 1/2 + c_1/sqrt(d) + c_2/d + c_3/d^{3/2} using bounds for d=2,...,20. Evaluate at d=2 for estimate of gamma_2.
implementation_hypothesis: Collect all known bounds for gamma_{2,d}. Fit asymptotic expansion. Predict gamma_{2,2}. Cross-validate by leave-one-out.
experiment_seed: Compile table of gamma_{2,d} bounds. Fit formula. Predict gamma_2. Validate on held-out data.
